name: Chamma Ling Valle de Bravo
tradition: Yungdrung Bon (pre-Buddhist Tibetan tradition, closely allied with Tibetan Vajrayana)
technique: Dzogchen-style Bon meditation, Tsa Lung inner-heat practices
teacherAccess: High when the lineage holder teaches in person; otherwise resident/visiting instructors
about: Home to the Great Stupa for World Peace, the largest Buddhist/Bon stupa in the West (consecrated 2010), this land has hosted Ligmincha retreats since 1999 with cabin and camping-style lodging. Note: Bon is a distinct pre-Buddhist Tibetan tradition rather than classical Buddhism, but it is closely allied with and commonly catalogued alongside Tibetan/Vajrayana practice -- included with that tradition caveat.
schedule: Periodic multi-day retreats, plus hybrid online sessions
cost: Lodging priced per person/night: quad cabin 750 MXN, triple 950 MXN, double 1,300 MXN; program tuition separate

pricePerDay.notes: Cabin lodging only (quad to double occupancy); tuition is additional.
